facts.fact: The Government of Mauritius issued version 1.0 of the Mauritius e-Government Interoperability Framework in November 2002, setting technical standards and specifications for interoperability across government information systems and data exchange between public agencies.

systems.owner: Government of Mauritius (Ministry of ICT; Central Informatics Bureau)
systems.tiers: government information systems and public agencies

note: Document is an excerpt-only summary; it states nothing on a decree making the framework compulsory or on bodies following it, so no fact on aspect use.
